title: Compactness under local mass bounds (Simon 2.15)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and every sequence T_q ∈ D_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) with sup_q M_W(T_q) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContainedOpen W U), there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and T₀ ∈ D_n(U) such that T_{φ(q)} ⇀ T₀ weakly in U and, for every continuous compactly supported n-form ω with tsupport ω ⊆ U and all measure representations (μ_q, v_q) of T_{φ(q)} and (μ₀, v₀) of T₀ (IsMeasureRepresentation), ∫ v_q(x)(ω(x)) dμ_q → ∫ v₀(x)(ω(x)) dμ₀.
